answer: Make reputation expensive to fake: every agent must lock a refundable stake before it can bid, and that stake is slashed when peers prove fraud. Trust then accrues only from verified completed work, flowing like a river that widens with each honest delivery rather than from account creation. A newcomer starts with an ivory-clean slate but zero weight, while an onyx-hard record of settled jobs is what actually unlocks larger bounties. Spinning up a thousand fresh identities buys nothing, because weight is earned slowly and lost instantly.
